title: Deeper/broader cross-peer evidence-routing matrix
mode: Primary-source web research and local plan reconciliation; plan-only
scope: Consolidate current open-source DWG/DXF route boundaries into an implementation-ready question-to-peer admission matrix.
Separate container validation, typed DWG decoding, DWG writing, DXF parsing/writing, OGR projection, and downstream application routes.
Preserve the fast local validation path and keep peer/native qualifications optional and non-blocking.

sources.revision: Mutable master manual accessed 2026-10-20; no executable or immutable commit pinned
sources.observed: The manual describes broad but ongoing coverage, identifies R2007 DWG writing as unsupported, says R2010-R2018 writing still fails CRC/audit checks, and lists enabled-but-unstable and broken/undertested object families. It also states the project came out of QCAD Community Edition code.
sources.limits: Project documentation is not an exact-release runtime result, conformance oracle, or evidence of current code reuse with libdxfrw.

sources.revision: Mutable master pages accessed 2026-10-20; no package or commit executed
sources.observed: The current matrix lists distinct DXF/DWG read/write operations. DWG reading is advertised through AC1021, while DWG writing is not advertised at AC1021; the matrix provides no per-entity denominator. The reader example exposes notifications.
sources.limits: Version/operation checkmarks are self-described route availability, not semantic or release-level test results.

sources.limits: No runtime, DXF, DWG, audit, recovery, or conversion was executed. Any future ODA-backed observation needs its own executable identity and output version.

sources.observed: Existing subplans already distinguish local generated tests, per-route peer evidence, and composed external/native qualification. This update consolidates admission/selection criteria without changing their sequence.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07: select an exact route-matched peer only for a named open question at the composed checkpoint
PAR-14: retain focused local validation and do not introduce per-slice peer or full-suite requirements
Consumer qualification: separate file-library evidence from OGR projection and native application behavior

planChanges: Added a question-to-route matrix distinguishing DWG structure, DWG semantic reading, DWG writing, DXF read/write, geospatial projection, and application routes.
Made exact operation/version/entity matching, source/runtime identity, strict-versus-recovery mode, per-source dispositions, and independently declared expected values explicit for optional peer use.
Added a stop rule: broad peer discovery ends here unless a later implementation slice reveals a concrete unresolved route question; missing peer availability does not block local implementation.
Reaffirmed that all testing drawings must be existing repository fixtures or locally generated from scratch; external peer fixtures and mutated external corpus files are not to be committed.
limitations: The cited repository pages are mutable and generally were not pinned to immutable commits or release artifacts in this pass.
No peer tool was executed, no parser output was compared, and no native application accepted any generated file.
Peer documentation establishes only the route classifications and stated limitations recorded here; it is not format authority or a reproduced support result.
